**Build features for scale and high availability:** cluster upscale, N: M and geo/warm redundancy (SRG), CP-GR switchover, and subscriber-session continuity during CP-UP communication failures.

Build and maintain containerized/virtual/cloud-based test environments (Docker, Kubernetes, SMI) and validate subscriber-scale, traffic, failover, upgrade/rollback, process-restart, and subscriber-churn scenarios.
  
Optimize control-plane performance, memory, and convergence for millions of subscribers across large UPF fleets.
  
Develop and maintain gRPC/REST APIs and YANG/OpenConfig models, plus CLI and model-driven telemetry for configuration and operational visibility.
  
Troubleshoot complex, distributed issues across CP, Silicon One UPFs, and the SMI/Kubernetes
